status_reason: Teacher graph nodes read against the exact source: SlotHead/Model forward, pooling parts, slot prior table and the original synthetic fingerprint check. Compiled on top of the reviewed renderer namespace (which already supplies TARGETS, GROUP, EVAL_BATCH, WeightsError, TTA_*, window_starts and predict_member). build_model (AutoModel.from_pretrained), find_weights/find_dinov2 (file search), infer_from_package (torch.load weights_only=False, ensemble/submission) and all training/label cells are NOT selected.

SlotHead.reason: Docstring only: describes per-diagnosis slot attention and study-level labels; no label access.

fingerprint.reason: Docstring only ('cannot' matches the annot token); synthetic uint8 bag, no file or label access.

exposed_evidence.window_logits: Model.forward output for each original predict_member TTA window, observed by a read-only forward hook; predict_member's own probabilities must equal the mean sigmoid of these logits bitwise.

not_exposed.slot_attention: SlotHead.forward computes `att` as a local variable and returns only logits; no original API returns it, so it is not collected.
not_exposed.patch_attention: Model.forward reads last_hidden_state only; backbone attentions are never requested by the original source.
not_exposed.per_slot_logits: The original head pools slots inside SlotHead; no per-slot logit exists in the source.

replaced_original_calls.build_model: Explicit Dinov2Model(Dinov2Config(**hash-bound config)); no from_pretrained/Hub/remote code; the backbone weights come only from the checkpoint's strict complete state.
replaced_original_calls.torch.load: weights_only=True on hash-verified in-memory bytes instead of the original weights_only=False.
